name: ActionContextMenu
description:
Right-click (long-press, Shift+F10, the Menu key) on a row or card opens exactly the
menu its ⋯ button opens (R11.6) — the same definition, the same item parts.
signature: <T>({ set, targets, label, children }: ActionContextMenuProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description:
The row or card that owns the actions. It must forward its ref and spread props; make
it focusable so Shift+F10 and the Menu key reach the menu from the keyboard.

props.name: set
props.description: Shared action definitions used by menus, headers and the command palette.

props.name: targets
props.description: Selected entities passed to action visibility, enablement, confirmation and execution.
